data_a.situation: The winding-stool floorboards at the market house around JC-5340 are worn, and a carpenter from Barleywick Clock-Weight Castings offered to quote.
known_facts: JC-5340 is the market-house going train.
Neris Holbeck's role is pendulum and chime-train fitting, not civic building work or keepership purchasing.
Calder Vossine handles keepership works orders and any instruction to outside carpenters.
Barleywick Clock-Weight Castings cast clock weights; they also keep a visiting carpenter.
constraints: Do not authorise keepership spending or instruct outside trades.
Keep the note to Calder Vossine only.
